title: Retrieval quiz: business activity (1.1 to 1.4)
subject: Business
source: Written for business/y11 lesson 31 (Complete the pupil PDF 1.1 to 1.4 retrieval quiz (20 questions) and mark it with the answers at the end.)
intro: 20 questions. Answer from memory, then mark with the mark scheme and correct in green.

questions.q: Name two financial aims of a business.
questions.a: Any two: survival, profit, growth, market share, financial security

questions.q: Name two non-financial aims.
questions.a: Any two: social objectives, personal satisfaction, challenge, independence and control

questions.q: What does SMART stand for?
questions.a: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound

questions.q: Give one reason a business's objectives might change.
questions.a: For example: market conditions, new technology, performance, legislation, internal reasons

questions.q: What is unlimited liability?
questions.a: The owner is personally responsible for all the business's debts; personal possessions can be used to pay them

questions.q: Which forms of ownership have limited liability?
questions.a: Private limited companies (Ltd) and public limited companies (plc)

questions.q: Where can shares in a plc be bought?
questions.a: By the public, on the stock exchange

questions.q: What is a franchise?
questions.a: The right to use another firm's brand and way of doing business in return for a fee and royalties

questions.q: Give one advantage of being a franchisee.
questions.a: For example: a known brand, training and support, lower risk

questions.q: What is a social enterprise?
questions.a: A business with mainly social aims that reinvests its profit to meet them

questions.q: Name two stakeholders of a business.
questions.a: Any two: owners/shareholders, employees, customers, suppliers, the local community, the government

questions.q: Give an example of a conflict between two stakeholders.
questions.a: For example: shareholders want higher profit, employees want higher pay

questions.q: Which sector extracts raw materials?
questions.a: Primary

questions.q: A car factory is in which sector?
questions.a: Secondary

questions.q: Give one reason the tertiary sector has grown in the UK.
questions.a: Higher incomes increase demand for services; manufacturing has moved abroad where costs are lower

questions.q: Name two factors affecting where a business locates.
questions.a: Any two: costs (rent, wages), the market, labour, raw materials, competitors, government help

questions.q: Why might a manufacturer locate near a motorway?
questions.a: Lower transport costs and faster deliveries to customers

questions.q: What is e-commerce?
questions.a: Buying and selling online

questions.q: Give one way e-commerce changes where a business needs to be.
questions.a: It no longer needs a shop where customers pass; it can use a cheaper warehouse

questions.q: Give one benefit to a business of having a clear mission statement.
questions.a: It tells staff and customers what the business stands for, so decisions stay focused
